mapper.select: select point_event_key , point_event_name , point_accu_type , case when point_accu_type='1' then '일반' when point_accu_type ='2' then '수기지급' else '미정의' end as point_accu_type_name , expire_days , max_unit_point from point_event_mst where point_accu_type = #{pointAccuType} order by point_event_key
mapper.update: update point_accu_mst set accu_cancel_yn = 'Y' where point_key = #{pointKey} and accu_cancel_yn = 'N' and accu_point = balance_point
mapper.select: select sum(a.point) as use_order_balance from point_order_use_hst a where a.order_no = #{orderNo}

select b.point_key , c.expired_date , c.point_accu_type , c.balance_point , d.point_accu_type , d.expire_days , c.point_event_key from point_order_use_hst a inner join point_order_use_map b on a.point_order_use_no = b.point_order_use_no inner join point_accu_mst c on b.point_key = c.point_key inner join point_event_mst d on c.point_event_key = d.point_event_key where a.order_no = #{orderNo} group by 1,2,3,4
